name: admin-chat-page-blank-issue
hook: Unit tests verify admin chat page renders correctly
body:
Issue #2544 reported /admin/chat renders blank. Investigation showed:
1. useCurrentUser hook correctly fetches user data
2. ChatInterface renders with admin welcome message
3. All tests pass in isolation
4. No code bug found - issue may be transient

Lesson: When QA reports blank page, verify with screenshot evidence. Test written to catch future regressions.
why: Without a screenshot, cannot reproduce the blank page issue. Code analysis and tests show component renders correctly.
